spans.s: cl. 1. P. गरति, to sprinkle, moisten, Dhātup. xxii, 39 (cf. √ घृ.)
[cf. γηρύω, γλῶσσα; Hib. goirim; Old Germ. quar, quir, &c.; Old Pruss. gerbu, ‘to speak’; Angl.Sax. gale; Germ. Nachtigal; Lat. gallus ?]
2. गॄ cl. 6. P. गिरति or (cf. Pāṇ. viii, 2, 21) गिलति (ŚBr. i; MBh.; Suśr.), ep. also Ā. गिरते (1. sg. गि॑रामि, AV. vi, 135, 3; perf. जगार, RV.; aor.

etym.s: [cf. √ 2. गल्, 2. गिर्, गिल, 2. गीर्ण॑; Lith. gerru, ‘to drink’; Lat. glu-tio, gula; Slav. gr-lo; Russ. žora.]

spans.s:
3. गॄ (= √ 3. कॄ) cl. 10. Ā. गारयते, to know, Dhātup. xxxiii, 33;
to make known, teach, ib.
